# Data

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `training_data.csv` | Training / evaluation data. Columns: `text, language, sentiment, aspect, severity, level` |
| `sample_feedback.csv` | Demo student submissions loaded by `scripts/seed_database.py` |

**Both files are SYNTHETIC.** They are generated by `python scripts/generate_dataset.py` from hand-written
phrase templates in English, Tamil, Hindi, Tanglish, Hinglish and code-mixed styles. They are **not real
college data**, and scores measured on them are optimistic. For real use, replace `training_data.csv` with
human-labelled feedback using the same columns and run `python training/train.py`.

* `level` = `clause` (one aspect) or `full` (whole feedback; `aspect` is `A|B` for several aspects).
* `sentiment` = Positive / Neutral / Negative. `severity` = Low / Medium / High / Critical.
